title: Credit Builder Accounts: The Amount a Late Fee Is Figured On
content:
A Credit Builder late fee for a late due date with no more than one debit card payment credited toward it is figured on an amount that depends on the payments credited toward that due date and on whether it is the account's maturity date. The late due date is the account's oldest unpaid due date, the next due date the account shows; the late-fee percent is applied to the amount set below.

## Rule

- Where one debit card payment has been credited toward the late due date, the fee is figured on the monthly payment less that payment, never on less than zero, instead of on the monthly payment; when a return points at that payment (a chargeback, code CB, or any other return of it), the payment is not netted and the fee is figured on the monthly payment.
- Where no debit card payment has been credited toward the late due date and that due date is the account's maturity date, the fee is figured on the final installment instead, which is the loan balance plus one month of interest on it at the APR divided by 1200, that interest rounded to the nearest cent, a half cent or more rounding up.
- Where neither is the case, the fee is figured on the monthly payment.

A debit card payment credited toward the late due date is a payment entry made by debit card whose installment due date is the late due date. A return points at a payment when a returned-payment entry names that payment as the one it reverses. The maturity date is the account's final due date, shown on the account record.

## Decision table

| Debit card payments credited toward the late due date | A return points at that payment? | Late due date is the maturity date? | Amount the fee is figured on |
|---|---|---|---|
| one | no | either | the monthly payment less that payment, never below 0.00 |
| one | yes | either | the monthly payment |
| none | not applicable | yes | the final installment: loan balance plus one month's interest at the APR divided by 1200, that interest rounded to the cent |
| none | not applicable | no | the monthly payment |

## Hypothetical figures

| Account | Amount the fee is figured on |
|---|---|
| monthly payment 100.00, one debit card payment of 40.00 toward the late due date, not returned | 100.00 less 40.00, that is 60.00 |
| the same, but that 40.00 payment was charged back (code CB) | 100.00 |
| monthly payment 100.00, one debit card payment of 120.00, not returned | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| no debit card payment; late due date is the maturity date; loan balance 98.00 at an APR of 12.00 | 98.00 plus 0.98, that is 98.98 |
| no debit card payment; late due date is not the maturity date; monthly payment 100.00 | 100.00 |
